name: clear_conversation_camera

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_ClearConversationCamera takes no Script context and calls func_0017FED8 without accessing the value stack

notes: func_0017FED8 clears the temporary conversation-camera active flag and, when the camera object exists and is not already terminating, starts its 30-tick return transition through func_001783D0. This is the cleanup counterpart to command 179 configure_conversation_camera_and_text_windows. The JP corpus contains five calls across al01.ard and pc06.ard.
